title: Novo Nordisk Already Has Weight-Loss Injections. Why Pursue Another Path?
author: 藥時事 Drugnews
summary: Why pursue non-incretin programs alongside an established GLP-1 franchise? K-554’s neural-circuit hypothesis, human evidence and usable dose range frame the relationship between efficacy, tolerability, persistence and product value.
cover_image_alt: Gut signals connect to appetite regulation in the brain on the left; laboratory research and abstract candidate molecules appear on the right. Both connect to a document for more treatment options. Undisclosed targets and unproven human value are stated.
